newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX crude, products hit by another selling wave.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX crude, products hit by another selling wave.

text.p: NYMEX crude and oil products futures were hit by another wave of selling ahead of the close, sending January crude down to another intraday low.
"There's been some very, very aggressive fund liquidiation, particularly in the spot (crude) nd were seeing January and February heat and gas contracts getting hit," said Gerry Samuels at ARB Oil.
The January crude contract hit a low at $23.15 before recovering to $23.35 at 1452 EST, while January gasoline was down 3.61 cents a gallon at 63.25 cents.
